{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 1
{w}For delicious wine with a nice ring to it......

Stop on by the "Turtle's Paradise"!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 2
{w}The end of another hard day.
Wouldn't you like to sit back with a tall cool one?

You can at the Turtles Paradise!!
Stop in today!
There's nothing like a smooth one after work!

{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 3
{w}Forget the bad times with a nice drink...

Only thing missing in Gold Saucer is......
A pub with good drinks and a great atmosphere!
Stop in the "Turtle's Paradise"!

{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 4
{w}Now hiring!
Looking for someone who can stand long hours of boredom!

For details, contact Pub "Turtle Paradise"!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 5
{w}Our cocktails are good but our wine is the best!

Please stop in to "Turtle's Paradise"!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise News No. 6
{w}Drink at the "Turtle's Paradise" And talk about Wutai!

You'll know "Turtle's Paradise" by the big pot outside!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise Flyer Campaign
{w}[Turtle's Paradise] is now having a Publicity flyer campaign.
They will be posted all over the world.
So make sure you look for our flyers that say "Turtle's Paradise"
There's six in all.
If you find them all, make sure to let the owner of Turtle's Paradise know.
You can win a prize!
Just reading them's good enough, so please don't take them down or rip them up!!
{g}--Owner, Turtle's Paradise

{g}This Week's Motto
{w}Shinra's Future Is The World's Future!!
Mako Energy For A Brighter World!!

{g}Men's Song
{w}Trust only in your own muscles
The sweat you shed never lies
Smile and keep jumping today
Hold back the tears and squat
That is the way of a man

{g}Zack's Letter
{w}Dear Dad and Mom,
How are you guys?
Sorry for leaving town so suddenly.
I just really wanted to become a SOLDIER.
I bet you're worried now that I've told you...
But now I'm fulfilling my lifelong dream, and I'll do my best in SOLDIER.
P.S. I have a girlfriend.
{g}- Zack

{g}Scratched on the Glass
{w}A scratch left by a fingernail inside the beaker...
'Let's get out of here...'.

{g}Scratched on the Glass
{w}A scratch left by a fingernail inside the beaker...
'Feeding Time'... that's our chance...!

{g}Escapee Report no. 1
{w}X Month X Day
The two escapees were located near Midgar.

{g}Escapee Report no. 2
{g}Description of the time of capture.
{w}A Former member of SOLDIER/Number( )
No effect could be detected from either Mako Radiation Therapy or Jenova on him.
B Regular/Number ( )
Reaction to Jenova detected.

{g}Escapee Report no. 3
{g}Concerning their disposal.
{w}A Shot for resisting.
B Escaped during A's resistance.

{g}Escapee Report no. 4
{g}Other
{w}B's whereabouts is currently unknown. But, we submit there is no need to pursue him, due to his diminishing consciousness. Awaiting further instructions.

{g}Hojo's Letter
{w}I must get rid of all those that stand in the way of my research.
Even that one from the Turks.
I scientifically altered him, and put him to sleep in the basement.
If you want to find him, then search the area.
But... this is merely a game I thought of.
It is not necessary for you to participate if you don't want to.

{g}Hojo's Letter
{w}Move the dial on the safe carefully, but quickly.
You have 20 seconds.
You can not go past the numbers while turning.
{g}The 4 hints for the numbers are...
{w}Dial 1: the lid of the box with the most oxygen
Dial 2: behind the ivories short of tea and ray
Dial 3: the creak in the floor by the chair...
From there: 5 left, 9 up, 2 left, 6 up.
